headline: Take-Two Interactive Shares Decline Following Grand Theft Auto VI Launch
summary: Take-Two Interactive shares dropped on the day of Grand Theft Auto VI's official global release despite widespread critical acclaim for the multi-billion dollar entertainment project.
why: Take-Two Interactive is a major American video game publisher known for high-budget interactive franchises.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.
impacts.why: Shares fell on launch day as investors realized sell-the-news profit-taking.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Trading profit-taking ensued following the long-awaited product release.
